capabilities: Render document embeds as compact file cards
Show a colored file-type icon per format
Open the linked file on click or keyboard activation
Wrap long filenames in full without truncation
Leave image, audio, video and note embeds native
disambiguation: Not an attachment manager; it only restyles existing document embeds as cards and does not move, rename or preview files.
extras: No settings to configure; no network requests or telemetry; note Markdown is unchanged and disabling the plugin restores native embeds. Runtime checks were done only on Windows with Obsidian 1.15.0 and the Blue Topaz theme; older versions and mobile are unverified.
motivation: To keep supporting files close in notes without letting them take over the writing.
problem: Document embeds such as PDFs and Office files take up large blocks of a note, pushing the surrounding text out of view.
summary: Turns PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and plain-text embeds into compact file cards with colored type icons that open the file when clicked.
